artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint James Minor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving architecture and figures. The artwork includes an architectural space, figures engaged in an event on stairs, clouds with light rays, an ascending figure in the sky, detailed line work, dynamic postures, dramatic facial expressions, and inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a scene with a ladder and a crowd. In the center, an elevated platform with a ladder can be seen with figures engaging in a public spectacle. The scene shows figures in motion with a sense of urgency. Above, there is a figure in the sky with lines around it, suggesting a supernatural element. The background includes architectural features like towers. The crowd below is depicted in various activities, with some looking up and others pointing or gesturing. Some are holding long poles or standards. The composition is detailed, creating a busy atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring buildings, a crowd, and an individual on a high platform. The scene shows numerous figures wearing robes and head coverings, facing the center. A person is seen on a structure connected by a ladder. Above the central building, a figure in the clouds is shown with radiant lines descending. The foreground is filled with a crowd focused on the event. The architecture exhibits classic styles with ornate details. The composition and lines suggest the use of etching or engraving to depict intricate details and convey shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Simon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene with a crowd and an elevated platform. The image features an arena setting with multiple people gathered around. A platform stands in the center, showcasing a figure. Above the scene, a celestial figure appears amongst clouds. The drawing includes architectural elements like columns and statues, and detailed expressions and interactions of the figures present.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows an interior with architectural and spiritual elements. The drawing depicts a grand hall with an elevated altar at the center, a large dome, and columns. Above the altar, a figure is suspended in the clouds, emitting radiant light. The architectural details are intricate, with strong use of lines and shading for depth and perspective.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Thaddeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with a celestial figure and a gathering of people in a plaza. A radiant figure emerges from the clouds above, casting rays toward a busy scene below, where a crowd surrounds a monumental structure with columns and an obelisk. Knights, clergy, and various individuals are depicted in dynamic poses, giving a sense of movement. The architectural elements suggest a classical setting, resembling ancient Roman grandeur. The structure is framed by ornate arches and detailed facades, adding depth to the image. The artwork captures a moment of divine intervention or revelation, as indicated by the radiant figure above and the gathering below.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures engaged in various activities. The drawing showcases a grand building with classical architectural elements such as columns, arches, and ornate stonework. In the center foreground, there are several figures, some standing on a platform. In the upper part of the image, a radiant figure is depicted emerging from the clouds. This scene is highly detailed with intricate line work, typical of engraving or etching techniques. The composition and style may be related to historical or biblical storytelling.

artworks.title: The Death of Judas
artworks.description: The image depicts a hanging figure with robed figures below and monstrous creatures above. The central figure is surrounded by robed figures in discussion or pointing. Above them are winged, grotesque creatures with wild, elongated limbs and monstrous features. The background includes a classical architectural element and a large, twisted tree with gnarled branches. Intricate line work is used to create depth and texture, especially in the clothing and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barnabas
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a celestial figure and a group of individuals. The image shows a figure in the clouds surrounded by radiant lines, with a group of individuals below engaged in an intense scene. The background includes large columns, creating a monumental atmosphere. The piece is rich with action and movement, with dynamic postures and an ethereal setting. The style is reminiscent of religious or historical illustrations, with intricate line work and a sense of grandeur.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for The Rules of the Order of Our Lady
artworks.description: The image shows a religious figure, resembling the Virgin Mary, standing in an elevated position surrounded by clouds and small angels or cherubs. She has a serene expression, delicate features, long hair, and is wearing flowing robes. A halo surrounds her head. The background features clouds and angels, giving a heavenly appearance. The scene is framed with an ornate border, and there is text in French mentioning the Congregation of Notre-Dame and the Jesuits below.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Prodigal Son"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the title page for "La Vie de L'Enfant Prodigue." The image features an ornate border framing a panel of text with the title and author. The border includes detailed linework depicting architectural features and a scene of two men engaged in a confrontation to the right. To the left, a figure is shown interacting with an animal. The scenes contribute to the drama of the title page. The drawing contains intricate engravings associated with 17th-century printmaking.

artworks.title: The Inheritance
artworks.description: This is an interior scene with a group of people around a table. The setting has large columns and detailed arches in the background. In the center, there is a table with people engaging in various activities. Some are handling chests or boxes, and two animals are present. The drawing shows precise line work and cross-hatching techniques typical of etching or engraving styles. The background architecture and detailed attire indicate a specific historical period. French script at the bottom likely describes the scene.

artworks.title: The Departure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene outside a gated city. The image depicts a busy street with horses, dogs, and various figures moving and interacting outside large stone buildings with an entrance gate visible in the background. The drawing captures dynamic movement, with figures involved in various activities and animals adding to the sense of liveliness. Architectural details include the stone structures, arched doors, and windows, while vibrant foliage is visible outside and above the walls. The composition is crowded, emphasizing a scene full of life. The lower portion of the drawing features text in cursive script.

artworks.title: The Dissipation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor banquet scene. The illustration depicts a group of people gathered around a long table laden with food under the sheltering canopy of trees. In the foreground, a person is dancing or gesturing with a staff. The scene shows a celebratory or social gathering with numerous figures actively participating. A fountain is visible in the left background, bordered by lush hedges and trees. Architectural elements suggest a building with arches and balconies where additional figures observe the gathering. The composition captures a lively moment of feast and social interaction, with detailed lines and etching complementing the text below that references wine and pleasure.

artworks.title: The Ruin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene with dynamic activity. The scene depicts various figures engaged in interactions in an urban setting, surrounded by classical architecture. In the foreground, several figures appear to be in motion, wielding sticks or rods, while a small dog runs across the street. The architecture has an intricate design, with arched windows and a grand staircase leading into one of the buildings. The background suggests a continuation of the street, with people gathered or watching from afar. The style and details of the figures' clothing and the architectural elements suggest a historical European setting. The caption at the bottom is in French.

artworks.title: The Swineherd
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a village gathering. A building with a thatched roof is on the right side, while trees and a path are on the left. A farmer interacts with another figure in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. Villagers and pigs are seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Praying for Divine Help
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from a higher perspective. A castle-like structure is seen in the distance, with trees and hills framing it. The artwork features detailed engravings with delicate linework, showcasing texture in trees and foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly black and white. In the foreground, a man is seen with pigs, surrounded by trees arching overhead. Text at the bottom provides additional narrative elements.

artworks.title: Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a grand architectural façade with an ornate staircase. Figures are gathered in various postures of interaction. The scene is set in an urban area, focused on a multi-story building with tall windows framed by intricate arch designs. The staircase leading to the entrance is adorned with detailed carvings. At its base, several figures engage in dynamic poses suggesting a narrative. The drawing employs fine lines and detailed shading to emphasize texture. In the background, more figures are visible through the windows. A dog stands in the foreground.

artworks.title: Killing the Fatted Calf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene. The image shows a courtyard surrounded by stone buildings, with various activities taking place. Sheep are being handled, alongside other animals such as horses. The roofs of the buildings are thatched or wooden. In the background, there is a round structure, likely a dovecote. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of early modern European prints. The scene captures a moment of daily life, with a focus on domestic productivity and the environment of a homestead.

artworks.title: The Parents Bestow Gifts
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtyard scene depicting an outdoor market or gathering. The illustration shows multiple figures in a stone courtyard enclosed by buildings, engaging in conversation and exploring items on tables. The architecture includes tall buildings with arched windows, and there is an archway leading to another area. French text below the scene provides context or commentary.

artworks.title: The Feast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. The image portrays a feast happening in an architectural setting with columns and arches. A long table is set for dining, with plates and goblets visible. In the background, a group of musicians is entertaining the attendees. Figures are shown engaging in activities like serving food and interacting with each other. To the left, another group of figures is moving around the space, while at the bottom, there is decorative text in French. The artist used intricate line work to render the details.

artworks.title: Saint John Preaching in the Desert
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.7 × 9.7 cm (3 1/16 × 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering in a natural amphitheater-like setting. The drawing features multiple figures gathered around a central platform or stage surrounded by large rocks and trees. The figures are wearing robes and some are wearing pointed hats. All are focusing on the central figure on the elevated platform. The scene is highly detailed, with intricate lines and shading capturing the texture of the landscape and the robes. Trees provide a natural canopy to the scene. Shadows and details convey depth and movement, highlighting the dynamic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for The Order of the White Penitents at Nancy
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals kneeling and praying in front of a large framed artwork or altar depicting a religious scene. The scene may be a pietà, with a robed and veiled figure holding another figure. Both individuals wear long, hooded robes. One of them has a small cross hanging from the neck area. Above the altar is an ornate architectural structure with an emblem or symbol at the top. Draped curtains form the backdrop. At the bottom of the altar is a Latin inscription "IN HOC SIGNO VINCES" with a cross inside a circle.

artworks.title: Entry into Ferrara
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures on horseback, with some individuals dressed in cloaks and wide-brimmed hats. In the foreground, there are two prominent figures riding donkeys or horses, their forms defined by flowing garments and detailed shading. In the background, an organized group of figures can be seen, many of whom appear to be carrying long spears. The overall composition is detailed with intricate line work, and the scene is set against the backdrop of fortified architecture with towers hinting at an entrance or a city gate.
